result.instructions: Tools for Mindee, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Mindee data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run mindee_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run mindee_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run mindee_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. mindee_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: mindee_list_models
tools.title: List extraction models
tools.description: List the document-extraction models available to your Mindee account (id, name, type). Use a model's `id` as the model_id for mindee_extract_document. V2 API: GET /v2/search/models.

tools.name: mindee_get_job
tools.title: Get job status
tools.description: Check the processing status of an enqueued document by job id. Status is Waiting | Processing | Processed | Failed. When Processed, the response carries a result_url; pass that inference id to mindee_get_inference. V2 API: GET /v2/jobs/{job_id}.

job_id.description: Job id returned by mindee_extract_document (when it times out) or an enqueue call.

tools.name: mindee_get_inference
tools.title: Get extraction result
tools.description: Fetch the structured result of a completed inference by id, returned as a compact map of extracted fields (plus raw_text if it was requested). V2 API: GET /v2/inferences/{inference_id}.

inference_id.description: Inference id (from a Processed job's result_url, or from mindee_extract_document).

raw.description: Return the full unshaped API response instead of the compact fields map. Default false.

tools.name: mindee_extract_document
tools.title: Extract data from a document
tools.description: Submit a document (PDF or image) to a Mindee extraction model and return the structured fields. Provide EITHER document_url (a public URL) OR file_base64 (+ filename). This enqueues an inference and polls until it completes (up to ~30s); if it is still processing it returns a job_id you can poll with mindee_get_job then read with mindee_get_inference. NOTE: consumes Mindee API credits (paid, billed per page). V2 API: POST /v2/inferences/enqueue.

document_url.description: Public URL of the document to process. Use this OR file_base64.

file_base64.description: Base64-encoded document bytes. Use this OR document_url; set `filename` too.

alias.description: Your own reference tag echoed back in the job/result.

webhook_ids.description: Webhook ids to notify on completion (async flows).

rag.description: Enable Retrieval-Augmented Generation for the model, if configured.

raw_text.description: Also return the full OCR raw text of the document.
